item.title: Eleven v4
item.description: ElevenLabs launched Eleven v4 on September 28, 2026, improving expressiveness and voice cloning (down to a 10-second sample) across more than 90 languages. Eleven v4 Turbo is the same model tuned for real-time use, running at roughly 100 milliseconds of median latency. Eleven v4 ranked first on the Artificial Analysis Provider Voice Arena leaderboard for September 2026, with about 75% of listeners preferring it over five rival services in blind tests.

item.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime
item.description: Alibaba released Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime on September 28, 2026 as the flagship of a five-model Qwen-Audio-3.1 stack that also covers speech recognition and text-to-speech. It’s built for full-duplex voice agents, meaning it can listen and respond at the same time and decide mid-conversation when to speak versus when to call an external tool.
